name: Word Break
description: Determines if a string can be segmented into words from a given dictionary using DP.
aim: Check if string s can be broken into dictionary words: dp[i] = can s[0..i-1] be segmented?
howItWorks: For each position i from 1 to n:
If dp[i-word.length] and s ends with word: dp[i] = true

complexity.spaceDescription: Boolean dp array of size n+1

whenToUse: Check if string decomposes into known words
alternatives: BFS — find shortest path in word graph

inputHint: The first word is the string; the words after it are the dictionary.
